title: Guide page guideline alignment — structural sections, FAQ depth, richer rendering
description: Bring every guide page into full conformance with the BestBikeFit4U guide page writing guideline. Adds missing structural sections (measure, adjust, warning signs, variations by rider type, practical recommendation), expands FAQs to 4–6, improves hero introductions, adds guide-specific CTA descriptions, and enables richer section rendering (numbered steps, prose, tables).
acceptance: Every guide has all five structural sections, 4–6 FAQs, a 2–3 sentence hero intro, a guide-specific CTA description, and the page template renders steps/prose/tables correctly. npx tsc --noEmit passes. Guideline §16 checklist passes for all guides.
